sloka: राक्षसो भैरव आकारो नित्यम् त्रासयते प्रजाः ।इमौ जनपदौ नित्यम् विनाशयति राघव ॥१-२४-२८॥
transliteration: rākṣaso bhairava ākāro nityam trāsayate prajāḥ ।imau janapadau nityam vināśayati rāghava ॥1-24-28॥

translations.english: "O Rama that wicked than Tataka carried on her depredations at regular intervals in these locations, Malada and Karusha.
